title: 带爸妈坐慢火车跨越山海，共赴一场温情旅程
description: 带爸妈坐一次慢火车穿过大半个中国，陪他们看一次海。
svg_data:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes wave { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-32px); } }
    @keyframes float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  </style>
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none">
    <!-- Far background: Distant hills -->
    <path d="M0 120 Q 100 80, 200 110 T 400 100" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.6"/>
    
    <!-- Midground: The Train (Hero) -->
    <g stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8">
      <rect x="120" y="130" width="160" height="40" rx="5"/>
      <line x1="120" y1="145" x2="280" y2="145"/>
      <circle cx="140" cy="170" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="260" cy="170" r="8"/>
      <rect x="160" y="135" width="20" height="20"/>
      <rect x="200" y="135" width="20" height="20"/>
      <path d="M120 130 L110 120" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Foreground: Figures and Sea -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6">
      <!-- Two Figures -->
      <path d="M180 125 Q 180 110, 185 100" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="185" cy="95" r="5"/>
      <path d="M195 125 Q 195 110, 190 100" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="190" cy="95" r="5"/>
      
      <!-- Sea waves (Animated) -->
      <path d="M0 190 Q 50 180, 100 190 T 200 190 T 300 190 T 400 190" stroke-dasharray="14 8" style="animation: wave 5s linear infinite"/>
      <path d="M0 205 Q 50 195, 100 205 T 200 205 T 300 205 T 400 205" stroke-dasharray="14 8" style="animation: wave 7s linear infinite"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Texture/Details -->
    <path d="M130 180 h40" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>
    <path d="M220 180 h40" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>
    
    <!-- Smoke (Animated) -->
    <path d="M270 130 Q 280 110, 275 90" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite"/>
  </g>
</svg>

title: 打造一款让用户产生深厚依赖的专属小产品
description: 做出一个属于自己的小产品，有几个人真的离不开它。
svg_data:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes wave { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-32px); } }
    @keyframes float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  </style>
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Defining Prop: A small glowing screen/device held by a figure -->
    <!-- Hero: A cozy, humble workshop/studio desk setup -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none">
      <path d="M120 160 h160" /> <!-- Desk -->
      <rect x="140" y="110" width="120" height="50" rx="4" /> <!-- Monitor/Product -->
      <rect x="150" y="120" width="100" height="30" /> <!-- Screen content -->
      <path d="M180 160 v20" /> <!-- Desk leg -->
      <path d="M220 160 v20" /> <!-- Desk leg -->
    </g>

    <!-- Figure: Gesture figure working on the product -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none">
      <path d="M260 130 c5 -20 10 -30 20 -30" /> <!-- Spine/Arm -->
      <circle cx="285" cy="90" r="6" /> <!-- Head -->
      <path d="M265 140 l10 20" /> <!-- Leg -->
    </g>

    <!-- Midground: Supporting elements (a plant and a mug) -->
    <g stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none">
      <path d="M125 160 q-5 -20 0 -30 m0 0 q5 10 10 0" /> <!-- Small plant -->
      <path d="M260 150 h15 v10 a5 5 0 0 1 -15 0" /> <!-- Mug -->
      <path d="M275 152 a3 3 0 0 1 0 6" /> <!-- Mug handle -->
    </g>

    <!-- Far background: Gentle horizon/hills and floating element -->
    <g stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none" opacity="0.7">
      <path d="M50 180 q150 -50 300 0" /> <!-- Distant hills -->
      <circle cx="330" cy="60" r="4" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite" /> <!-- Guiding star -->
      <path d="M330 65 v5" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite" /> <!-- Star light -->
    </g>

    <!-- Texture/Hatching -->
    <g stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.5">
      <path d="M130 165 h20 M155 165 h20 M230 165 h20" /> <!-- Shadow hatching -->
      <path d="M125 155 l-5 5 M135 155 l-5 5" /> <!-- Plant texture -->
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

title: 每周两次与水相拥，找回身体的轻盈与掌控感
description: 每周去游两次泳，重新住回自己的身体里。
svg_data:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes wave { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-32px); } }
    @keyframes float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  </style>
  <g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Far Background: Distant hills -->
    <path d="M50 120 Q120 80 200 110 T350 100" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.7"/>
    
    <!-- Midground: The Pool (The Hero) -->
    <!-- Pool edges -->
    <path d="M80 150 L320 150 L340 180 L60 180 Z" stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <!-- Water surface / waves -->
    <path d="M70 155 Q100 145 130 155 T190 155 T250 155 T310 155" stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="14 8" style="animation: wave 5s linear infinite"/>
    
    <!-- Hero Subject: Gesture figure mid-stroke -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6">
      <path d="M150 155 Q160 140 175 145" /> <!-- Torso -->
      <circle cx="178" cy="142" r="5" /> <!-- Head -->
      <path d="M175 148 L190 165" /> <!-- Arm reaching -->
      <path d="M155 158 L140 175" /> <!-- Leg kicking -->
    </g>

    <!-- Defining Prop: Floating kickboard -->
    <rect x="220" y="148" width="30" height="20" rx="5" stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6"/>
    
    <!-- Foreground: Pool ladder -->
    <path d="M330 145 L330 170 M345 145 L345 170 M330 150 L345 150 M330 160 L345 160" stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6"/>

    <!-- Texture / Detail -->
    <path d="M85 175 l5 -3 M95 175 l5 -3 M300 175 l5 -3" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.7"/>
    
    <!-- Atmosphere: Floating mist/bubbles -->
    <circle cx="280" cy="130" r="2" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite"/>
    <circle cx="290" cy="125" r="3" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite"/>
  </g>
</svg>
